content.title: Thunder vs Lakers highlights: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, OKC win, cut magic number to one
content.text: April 7, 2026Updated April 8, 2026, 12:00 a.m. CTLOS ANGELES — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the OKC Thunder will face Deandre Ayton and the Los Angeles Lakers at Crypto.com Arena on Tuesday night.OKC (62-16) cruised to a 146-111 home win over the Utah Jazz on Sunday. Los Angeles (50-28) fell short in a 134-128 road loss to the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday.Entering play Tuesday, the Thunder's magic number to capture the top seed in the Western Conference was two.Follow along for live updates throughout tonight's Thunder-Lakers game:Order new book on Thunder's run to NBA titleThunder vs Lakers score updates[ LISTEN UP: Make the "Thunder Buddies" podcast a staple of your starting lineup by following onApple,Spotify andYouTube. ]Final: Thunder 123, Lakers 87 | OKC closing in on top seed in WestShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 25 points and 8 assistsChet Holmgren: 15 points and 10 boardsIsaiah Joe: 18 points and 2 boardsJared McCain: 15 points and 2 boardsOKC (63-16) can secure the top seed in the West tomorrow with either a win over the LA Clippers or a Spurs loss to the Trail Blazers.End of the third quarter: Thunder 93, Lakers 62 | SGA extends 20-point streakShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 25 points and 8 assistsChet Holmgren: 15 points and 10 reboundsIsaiah Joe: 18 points and 2 reboundsOKC is shooting 54.1% from the field, 55.2% from deep and 91.7% from the free-throw line.Halftime: Thunder 65, Lakers 47 | SGA, OKC pulling awayShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 15 points and 6 assistsIsaiah Joe: 12 pointsChet Holmgren: 6 points and 7 reboundsEnd of the first quarter: Thunder 34, Lakers 27 | SGA, OKC up on shorthanded LAShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 11 points and 5 assistsIsaiah Joe: 9 pointsChet Holmgren: 6 points and 3 boardsWhat time is Thunder vs Lakers game tonight?Date: Tuesday, April 7Time: 9:30 p.m. CTWhere: Crypto.com Arena in Los AngelesWatch Thunder vs Lakers live on FuboWhat channel is OKC Thunder vs Los Angeles Lakers on tonight?TV: FanDuel Sports NetworkHow to watch online: Fubo (free trial)Thunder vs Lakers predictions, picksJustin Martinez: OKC 119, Los Angeles 94This is a bad matchup for Los Angeles, which was proven in its 43-point loss to OKC on Thursday. The Lakers struggled to take care of the basketball and slow down the pace due to the Thunder's turnover-forcing defense. And they also didn't have a ton of options to throw at Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, especially with Marcus Smart sidelined. Now, Los Angeles won't have Luka Doncic or Austin Reaves in Tuesday's rematch either. Even without Jalen Williams, OKC should win this game.Thunder vs Lakers betting oddsOdds via BetMGM as of Tuesday, April 7Odds: Thunder by 15.5Over/under: 220.5Moneyline: OKC -2500 | Los Angeles +1100Thunder vs Lakers injury updatesThunder: Thomas Sorber (right ACL surgical recovery) is out. Jalen Williams (right hamstring injury management) is out.Lakers: Luka Doncic (left hamstring strain) is out. LeBron James (left foot injury management) is out. Austin Reaves (left oblique muscle strain) is out.
